For a weekly-rebalanced trend book with no evidence of a signal flip, rebuilding all 14 legs on guesses would add churn cost and noise without adding signal. Holding keeps the existing stops (all with ample cushion; the GLD short's stop is about 17% above the current mark) and the 17% cash at 4% APY.
